items.title: Render a time-only separator at the existing ten-minute gap
items.precondition: Isolated app runtime with a conversation containing same-day messages that can be sent at controlled intervals.
steps: Send two same-day messages less than ten minutes apart and inspect the timeline.
Send another same-day message at least ten minutes after its predecessor.
Inspect the separator immediately above that message.
items.expected: No separator appears below the threshold. At or above ten minutes, one separator appears with a local time only, such as '9:18 PM'; it contains no month, day, or year.
items.evidence: User-confirmed local acceptance on 2026-08-08. Automated verification also returned '9:18 PM', rejected an invalid date with an empty label, and confirmed the 600000 ms threshold.
items.notes: No separate browser recording was supplied; user confirmation is the behavioral acceptance evidence.

items.title: Preserve day boundaries and message grouping
items.precondition: Same isolated runtime with messages on two calendar days and consecutive same-sender messages.
steps: Open the conversation across a calendar-day boundary.
Confirm the day label above the first message on the new day.
Inspect adjacent same-sender messages on both sides of a sub-ten-minute gap.
items.expected: The day label remains present at the boundary. Existing message grouping remains unchanged, and no new full-date gap label is introduced.
items.evidence: User-confirmed local acceptance on 2026-08-08. Project and frontend typechecks and the frontend production build passed; frontend lint exited 0 with six pre-existing warnings outside this change.
items.notes: No separate browser recording was supplied; user confirmation is the behavioral acceptance evidence.
